description.zh:
整數運算

你已熟悉 +、-、*。在 C++ 中，兩個 int 相除 / 得到整數商；% 是餘數：

cout << 17 / 3 << endl;   // 5
cout << 17 % 3 << endl;   // 2

若至少一個運算元是 double，/ 才會得到小數：

cout << 17.0 / 3 << endl; // 5.66667

浮點數

讀入小數：

double x;
cin >> x;
cout << x << endl;

範例輸入

1.492

輸出

1.492

非常大或非常小的數可用科學記號，例如 1.496e11。

朝零捨去小數可用 (int)x：

cout << (int)1.3 << endl;  // 1
cout << (int)1.7 << endl;  // 1
cout << (int)(-1.3) << endl; // -1

四捨五入可用 round(x)（需 #include <cmath>）：

cout << round(1.3) << endl;  // 1
cout << round(1.7) << endl;  // 2
cout << round(-1.7) << endl; // -2

浮點運算可能有微小誤差：

cout << 0.1 + 0.2 << endl;  // 0.3（顯示可能略長）

做題時請依測資格式輸出小數，常用 #include <iomanip> 的 fixed 與 setprecision(n)：

cout << fixed << setprecision(2) << 3.14159 << endl;  // 3.14

cmath 與 iomanip

<cmath> 提供數學函式（需 #include <cmath>）：

cout << sqrt(9) << endl;    // 3
cout << floor(1.7) << endl; // 1
cout << ceil(1.3) << endl;  // 2
cout << abs(-5) << endl;    // 5

常用函式：

  • floor(x) — 不大於 x 的最大整數
  • ceil(x) — 不小於 x 的最小整數
  • sqrt(x) — 平方根
  • abs(x) — 絕對值

本章題目涉及位數、小數、時間與角度等，請善用整除、餘數、double 與格式化輸出。閱讀完畢後，點選「下一題」開始練習。
description.en:
Integer arithmetic

You already know +, -, and *. In C++, dividing two int values with / gives an integer quotient; % is the remainder:

cout << 17 / 3 << endl;   // 5
cout << 17 % 3 << endl;   // 2

If at least one operand is double, / yields a floating-point result:

cout << 17.0 / 3 << endl; // 5.66667

Floating-point numbers

Read a decimal:

double x;
cin >> x;
cout << x << endl;

Sample input

1.492

Output

1.492

Very large or small values can use scientific notation, e.g. 1.496e11.

Truncate toward zero with (int)x:

cout << (int)1.3 << endl;  // 1
cout << (int)1.7 << endl;  // 1
cout << (int)(-1.3) << endl; // -1

Round with round(x) (#include <cmath>):

cout << round(1.3) << endl;  // 1
cout << round(1.7) << endl;  // 2
cout << round(-1.7) << endl; // -2

Floating-point math can have tiny rounding errors—match the expected output format in each problem. Use fixed and setprecision(n) from <iomanip>:

cout << fixed << setprecision(2) << 3.14159 << endl;  // 3.14

cmath and iomanip

<cmath> provides math functions:

cout << sqrt(9) << endl;
cout << floor(1.7) << endl;
cout << ceil(1.3) << endl;
cout << abs(-5) << endl;

Common functions:

  • floor(x) — largest integer not greater than x
  • ceil(x) — smallest integer not less than x
  • sqrt(x) — square root
  • abs(x) — absolute value

Problems cover digits, decimals, time, and angles—use division, modulo, double, and formatted output. When ready, click Next below.
